title: Money: Managing transactions
subtitle: Understanding everyday money transactions
summary: Learn how to recognise money coming in and going out, record everyday payments, and check transaction details. This introductory overview encourages keeping simple records and reviewing balances after making payments.

title: Planning: Make a monthly budget
subtitle: Planning a monthly budget
summary: A budget helps organise income, essential expenses, savings, and discretionary spending. Start with what you earn or receive, list regular expenses, and review your plan as your needs change.

title: Banking: Financial inclusion
subtitle: Banking and financial inclusion
summary: Financial inclusion means making useful financial services easier for people to access. Explore basic bank accounts, deposits, payments, and why understanding account terms matters.

title: Insurance: Safety nets
subtitle: Insurance and financial safety nets
summary: Insurance can help protect against certain financial risks. Learn about premiums, coverage, exclusions, and why it is important to compare policies and read the terms before choosing one.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
subtitle: Financial inclusion · Banking · English
summary: PMJDY helps people without a bank account access essential banking services. It offers a basic savings account with no minimum balance requirement, interest on deposits and a RuPay debit card. Eligible account holders may receive accident insurance benefits and an overdraft facility of up to ₹10,000. The scheme also supports direct transfer of government benefits into bank accounts.
